# Akbar M A — Cyronix Dev & Security

> Akbar M A is a CEH-certified cybersecurity researcher based in Dubai, UAE, and the Founder & CEO of Cyronix Dev & Security — a cybersecurity and secure web development company.

## Summary
Cyronix Dev & Security provides penetration testing, vulnerability assessment (VAPT), security audits, OSINT, incident-response support, and OWASP-hardened secure web development. Akbar M A holds the Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH v11) certification and is familiar with regional frameworks such as NESA and the Dubai Cyber Security Strategy.

## Key Pages
- [Portfolio](https://akbar.cyronixsecurity.com/): Full profile, experience, projects, certifications and contact details.
- [Cyronix Dev & Security](https://www.cyronixsecurity.com): Company site.

## Live Tools (free, built by Cyronix)
- [Security Auditor](https://securityaudit.cyronixsecurity.com/): Scans any domain's HTTP security headers and TLS configuration, grading it against OWASP best practice.
- [Live Threat Map](https://threats.cyronixsecurity.com/): Real-time global cyber-attack visualization tracking live threat activity across regions.
